brief:
One surviving beehive has emerged as a symbol of hope amid the widespread destruction across the Gaza Strip, the Palestine News Network reported. The war devastated agriculture, livestock, and the environment while displacing thousands of families from their livelihoods and destroying homes throughout the territory.

The beehive represents local efforts to preserve Gaza's natural and agricultural heritage during the broader humanitarian crisis. As communities confront the scale of destruction, residents have focused on maintaining the surviving colony as part of broader attempts to rebuild their shattered economy and restore food systems across the war-damaged enclave.

title: Single beehive becomes symbol of survival in war-torn Gaza
